charts.title: TIC 270471727 b: orbits around TIC 270471727
charts.description: The orbits of TIC 270471727's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TIC 270471727 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 10.45629771649 d

charts.title: TIC 270471727 b: its transit
charts.description: TIC 270471727 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (93, 94, 95) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 270471727, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 17 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 14-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min late; 14-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
